name: Elemental Healing Spell-like Ability (Monster, Mythic)
body:
You become a master of elemental life force.

Prerequisite(s): Elemental Healing Spell-like Ability, 3rd mythic rank or tier.

Benefit: If the spell-like ability you have chosen to modify with Elemental Healing Spell-Like Ability can be used more than three times per day, you can use this feat an additional number of times per day equal to one-third your mythic rank (minimum 1). When you have expended your daily uses of this feat, you may choose to spend two uses of your mythic power as a free action to gain an additional use of the feat.

In addition, by expending two daily uses of this feat, you may apply Elemental Healing Spell-Like Ability to a different spell-like ability you possess. This spell-like ability must be one whose spell level does not exceed one-half your caster level (round down) -3. If you cannot use an elemental healing spell-like ability at least twice per day, you cannot use this ability.
